date: Nov 24, 2026 · Week 3 / Day 2 · Upward communication and influence

cards.title: Answer the objection, not the tone
cards.question: Your director says PCIe passed last build. Why spend another lab day on it?
cards.selfCheck: Acknowledge the prior pass, then show what changed and the release exposure. Ask for a bounded test with a decision threshold.
cards.prompt: Role-play a skeptical director. Challenge my 25-second case for retesting PCIe after a stackup change; score evidence, consequence and ask.

cards.title: Make their constraint part of the plan
cards.question: Mechanical rejects a connector change that improves SI margin. How do you earn support?
cards.selfCheck: Ask which mechanical constraint is nonnegotiable. Compare alternatives against shared system criteria and agree on a joint recommendation.
cards.prompt: Role-play a mechanical lead resisting a connector ECO. Help me negotiate a feasible alternative without compromising required SI margin.

cards.title: Disagree without overstating
cards.question: A lead calls an 18 MHz PDN peak harmless because the regulator is stable. How do you challenge that?
cards.selfCheck: Separate regulator stability from load-transient compliance. Request load spectrum and droop evidence; state what would change your position.
cards.prompt: Role-play a power architect. Critique my respectful challenge to a PDN signoff claim and help me define decisive evidence.

cards.title: Ask for capacity, not sympathy
cards.question: EM/TDR correlation is blocked by a shared VNA booking. What should your manager hear?
cards.selfCheck: Quantify the decision delay and competing priorities. Recommend a specific lab slot or alternative test, with an owner and deadline.
cards.prompt: Act as my manager with scarce lab capacity. Make me justify a VNA slot against another program and propose a fallback.

cards.title: Make the dissent actionable
cards.question: A crosstalk waiver is gaining support despite incomplete worst-case data. Give a 30-second dissent.
cards.selfCheck: State the risk first, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and propose a decision gate. Record residual risk and the authorized decision owner.
cards.prompt: Simulate a release review where everyone favors a crosstalk waiver. Score my concise dissent, evidence threshold and constructive alternative using Weeks 1–2 skills.
